variant_decisions.evidence: The candidates differ only as -sthe/-sthai, an itacistic pair distinguishing a second-plural imperative from an infinitive used imperativally. ASV 'be not fashioned' is a direct prohibition, which is the natural rendering of either form, so the English does not distinguish them. Both mapped notes are alternative_rendering ('Or, age'; the alternate construal of the will of God) and cannot decide a reading. Base fallback retained.

Same itacistic pair as the preceding unit: metamorphousthe (imperative) against metamorphousthai (infinitive). No textual_variant note is mapped here. Base fallback retained.
